title: Find out why the Effects plus goes nameless while the panel is settling
goal: A tutorial walk looked for the plus on the Effects heading and could not find it by name, once, while the panel was still moving. It found the control but with no name on it. If that can happen to a walk it can happen to a screen reader, so it is worth knowing whether the name really goes away or whether the walk simply looked too early.
notes:
Seen on 2026-09-13 in Scripts/playtest-all.sh --no-build tutorial- , which was running while other probe work was going on, so the machine was loaded.

The failure: step 17 (panelMenu): no menu called "Add Effect" is in the window; the ones that are: 100% 58.0pt wide at x 801.5 says "Choose a zoom level...", Fill 42.0pt wide at x 1051.5 says "Save this fill as a named style...",  25.0pt wide at x 1123.0 says "Add an effect: a shadow, a glow, a border or a blur".

Note the third entry: the Add Effect menu IS there, at the right size, with the right help text, and with an EMPTY name. Sources/Photonz/EffectsListInspector.swift:917 sets .accessibilityLabel("Add Effect") on it.

Ran twice again immediately afterwards on an idle machine: ok both times. The log line before the failure says the wait never went quiet (14 of 16 slices busy), so the panel was still laying out.

Not reproduced on demand, which is why this is p2 and phrased as a question.
acceptance: The walk tutorial-add-a-shadow-a-border-a-glow passes ten times in a row
Either the cause is found and fixed, or it is written down as a timing limit of the walk and the walk waits for the panel instead of sleeping
